title: Designed and taught a SOLID principles series
summary: I designed and taught a talk series on SOLID design principles to build developers' design skills; one talk was rated 8.6 out of 10 from 37 responses.
what_would_have_happened: Developers would keep meeting design principles as abstract rules, without worked examples.
the_call: Teach one principle per talk, with concrete examples.
what_i_did: Designed and delivered the series and collected participant feedback.
what_changed: One talk scored 8.6 out of 10 from 37 responses; a participant called it 'INCREDIBLE'.

quotes.text: This presentation was INCREDIBLE. Kudos to Datta; it was really clear.
